name: rustic
description: `self-update` (feature-gated out of default build) overwrites binary, never calls verify APIs.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the reviewed rustic snapshot, self-update is compiled behind the self-update feature; enabled builds configure the rustic GitHub backend and call its release.update method, while builds without the feature report that package-manager updating is required. Verification performed inside the delegated dependency is unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; delegated self_update verification behavior and release-specific controls were not inspected.

original_evidence.text: | **rustic** (github.com/rustic-rs/rustic) | Y | N (manual `rustic self-update` subcommand; feature-gated, not in default build) | Y (downloads GitHub release binary/archive and replaces the running executable in place) | https (GitHub API + release-asset download via `reqwest` w/ `rustls`, standard TLS cert validation; no cert pinning) | unknown/no (no separate signed manifest — release metadata comes straight from GitHub Releases API) | none observed (rustic invokes the `self_update` crate's default GitHub backend flow and never calls the crate's optional `.verifying_keys()`/checksum APIs) | n/a (no verifying key configured) | `rustic/src/commands/self_update.rs:31-58` (self_update::backends::github::Update, `release.update()`); `rustic/Cargo.toml:36` (`self-update = ["dep:self_update","dep:semver"]`, opt-in feature); `rustic/Cargo.toml:125` (`self_update = "0.44.0"`, features `rustls`,`reqwest`) |
